I was singing and thinking about what I was going to do next. My sister was looking for her doll. Then, Mom was asking us for help. Soon, we were cleaning, washing, and opening windows. While we were working and talking, Dad was reading. By the evening, we were tired, so we all liked sleeping! Estaba cantando y pensando en lo que iba a hacer después.
